description: Resolve a historical shared-comparison token to its canonical comparison slug. A successful response contains redirect_to and result: "redirect"; it does not return the historical comparison body. Unknown or retired tokens return 404. Cache-only.

snapshot_id.description: The token at the end of a historical shared-comparison link (https://lianex.ai/s/<token>). The API never lists these tokens; you only get one from such a link.

name: lianex_share_comparison_by_snapshot_id
title: A historical comparison-link redirect
